column1: # comment: "logic:\u2194OntoUML metamodel-vocabulary bridge (by reference). The logic: stereotype meta-classes (Kind, SubKind, Role, Phase, Category, Mixin, RoleMixin, PhaseMixin, Relator) ARE the OntoUML/UFO leaf stereotypes the native foundation disciplines range over, so each is a genuine, invertible 1:1 pun with its counterpart in the OntoUML metamodel vocabulary (https://w3id.org/ontouml#, the serialization the FAIR OntoUML/UFO model catalog uses) \u2014 hence skos:exactMatch. The metamodel vocabulary is CC BY-SA 4.0 (ReferenceOnly under the native license policy), so the alignment is BY REFERENCE only: no OntoUML axioms are vendored and no imports/targets snapshot is committed; each object IRI is a real ontouml: stereotype individual verified against the live vocabulary. This is the ontological-use/dogfooding counterpart of the external correctness corpus (conformance/logic/cases/external/ontouml-mini), which grades the SAME disciplines against the community's documented anti-pattern verdicts."

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — out-of-fragment stereotypes): the OntoUML stereotypes outside the endurant-sortal + relator fragment the five disciplines cover — «collective», «quantity», «mode», «quality», «type», «historicalRole», «event», «situation», «datatype», «enumeration», «abstract» — have no logic: counterpart to bear an exactMatch pun and are deliberately NOT aligned; they are the vocabulary residue an out-of-fragment catalog model surfaces as a capability gap (conformance/logic/cases/external/ontouml-mini-divergence).

# # NOTE (anti-pattern taxonomy → logic:Discipline): the OntoUML anti-pattern catalogue (https://ontouml.readthedocs.io/en/latest/anti-patterns/) is prose documentation with no per-anti-pattern RDF IRI, so it is NOT aligned as SSSOM cells (Principle 5 — no fabricated IRIs, and Principle 17 — a detected smell is not owl:equivalentClass to a detector rule). The five native logic:Discipline individuals (FreeRole, MixIden, MixRig, RelComp, StereotypeCardinality) already carry that anti-pattern as their skos:definition; the catalogue anti-patterns with NO native discipline (RepRel, HetColl, RelSpec, ImpAbs, and the rest) are the honest formalization backlog, pinned by conformance/logic/cases/external/ontouml-mini-divergence rather than papered over with a bridge cell.

column7: The OntoUML «category» stereotype: a rigid non-sortal aggregating essential properties across kinds — the counterpart of logic:Category.
The OntoUML «kind» stereotype: a rigid, identity-providing sortal — the counterpart of logic:Kind.
The OntoUML «mixin» stereotype: a semi-rigid non-sortal — the counterpart of logic:Mixin.
The OntoUML «phase» stereotype: an anti-rigid, intrinsically-founded sortal — the counterpart of logic:Phase.
The OntoUML «phaseMixin» stereotype: an anti-rigid non-sortal phase dispersed across kinds — the counterpart of logic:PhaseMixin.
The OntoUML «relator» stereotype: a mediating truth-maker of a material relation — the counterpart of logic:Relator.
The OntoUML «role» stereotype: an anti-rigid, relationally-dependent sortal — the counterpart of logic:Role.
The OntoUML «roleMixin» stereotype: an anti-rigid non-sortal role dispersed across kinds — the counterpart of logic:RoleMixin.
The OntoUML «subkind» stereotype: a rigid sortal specializing a kind — the counterpart of logic:SubKind.
